quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so a precise, specific claim follows and grounds a more general statement.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph explaining why a clinic reduced patient waiting times
options: Average patient waiting time at the clinic dropped noticeably after a new scheduling system was introduced.
A more precise schedule, it turns out, does more for patients than a longer clinic day ever could.
Specifically, the average wait fell from twenty-three minutes to nine minutes over the following quarter.
The improvement came from spacing appointments according to each visit's expected length rather than treating every slot the same.
quests.hint: The precise detail should replace a vague phrase like 'noticeably' with an exact number, and it should follow immediately after the general claim it sharpens.
quests.explanation: The general claim states the pattern in broad terms. The precise detail immediately sharpens it with an exact figure, giving the reader something concrete rather than a vague impression. The explanation accounts for the improvement, and the closing line draws the lesson.
quests.thesisStatement: A scheduling system based on expected visit length reduced average patient waiting time from twenty-three minutes to nine.

quests.instruction: Arrange this paragraph so a vague claim is immediately sharpened with a precise, specific figure.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph explaining why a factory reduced material waste
options: Material waste at the factory fell significantly after switching to smaller, more frequent supply orders.
Ordering closer to actual weekly need meant less material sat unused long enough to become obsolete or damaged.
Specifically, unused material sitting in storage dropped by forty-two percent within two months of the change.
Precision in ordering, not a cheaper supplier, was what actually delivered the saving.
quests.hint: The precise detail should turn 'significantly' into an exact percentage, positioned right after the general claim it sharpens.
quests.explanation: The general claim states the pattern broadly. The precise detail immediately replaces vagueness with an exact figure, and the explanation accounts for why that figure occurred. The closing line draws the specific lesson, naming precision rather than price as the real cause.
quests.thesisStatement: Switching to smaller, more frequent supply orders reduced factory material waste by forty-two percent within two months.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so a general statement is followed immediately by the specific number that gives it real weight.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph explaining why a school's new reading programme improved literacy scores
options: Fifteen minutes of guided reading every morning gave students consistent practice that occasional assigned reading had never reliably provided.
Consistency, measured in minutes rather than intentions, is what actually moved the numbers.
Specifically, average reading scores rose by eleven percentage points over a single academic year.
Literacy scores among younger students rose meaningfully after the school introduced its new daily reading programme.
quests.hint: The precise detail should replace 'meaningfully' with a specific percentage, placed directly after the general claim it strengthens.
quests.explanation: The general claim states the pattern broadly. The precise detail replaces vagueness with an exact percentage, and the explanation accounts for the mechanism behind that improvement. The closing line draws the specific lesson about consistency.
quests.thesisStatement: A daily fifteen-minute guided reading programme raised literacy scores by eleven percentage points over one academic year.

quests.instruction: This paragraph replaces a vague quality word with something measurable. Order it so the measurable version does the real work.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph arguing that a company's new onboarding process is genuinely more effective than the old one
options: A feeling can be argued with; a measured number is harder to dismiss.
Saying the new onboarding process 'feels better' tells a manager very little about whether it actually works.
What matters is that new hires under the new process reach full productivity in an average of eighteen days instead of thirty-one.
That thirteen-day difference reflects real time saved, not just a friendlier first impression.
quests.hint: The paragraph should move from naming a vague, unmeasurable claim to replacing it with something a manager could actually verify.
quests.explanation: The vague claim is named first to show what it fails to establish. The measurable replacement then gives the reader something genuinely checkable, and the supporting detail confirms the significance of that number. The closing line contrasts a feeling with a fact.
quests.thesisStatement: The new onboarding process is measurably more effective, cutting the time to full productivity by thirteen days.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so a vague descriptive word is replaced by something a reader could actually verify.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph arguing that a redesigned website is genuinely easier to use than the old one
options: That four-minute difference reflects fewer confusing steps, not simply a fresh coat of visual polish.
Calling the new website 'more user-friendly' does not tell anyone whether visitors actually find it easier to use.
A claim about ease of use means little until someone actually measures the time it takes.
What can be measured is that the average time to complete a purchase dropped from six minutes to just under two.
quests.hint: The paragraph should name the unmeasurable claim first, then replace it with an exact, checkable figure.
quests.explanation: The vague claim is named first to expose what it fails to prove. The measurable replacement then offers a specific, verifiable figure, and the supporting detail explains what that figure reflects. The closing line reinforces why measurement matters more than impression.
quests.thesisStatement: The redesigned website is measurably easier to use, cutting average purchase time by four minutes.

quests.instruction: Arrange this paragraph so an unverifiable claim about quality is replaced by a specific, checkable measurement.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph arguing that a new employee training video is genuinely more effective than the old one
options: Describing the new training video as 'more engaging' says nothing about whether employees actually retain what it teaches.
That seventeen-point gap reflects genuine improvement in retention, not simply a livelier presentation style.
What can actually be measured is that quiz scores immediately after watching rose from an average of sixty-four percent to eighty-one.
Engagement is easy to claim; retention is the number that actually settles the question.
quests.hint: The paragraph should first name the vague, subjective claim, then replace it with a precise figure that could actually be checked.
quests.explanation: The vague claim is named first to expose its limits. The measurable replacement offers a specific, checkable figure, and the supporting detail interprets what that figure actually reflects. The closing line contrasts an easy claim with a settled measurement.
quests.thesisStatement: The new training video is measurably more effective, raising quiz scores by seventeen percentage points.

quests.instruction: Order this formal email so its register stays consistently professional throughout.
quests.essayTopic: Write a formal email requesting a short extension on a project deadline
options: I am writing to request a short extension on the deadline for the quarterly report.
I would appreciate an extension of three business days, which should allow enough time to finalise accurate figures.
Thank you for considering this request, and please let me know if further information would be helpful.
A supplier delay has left several figures unconfirmed, through no fault of our team's own scheduling.
quests.hint: Every sentence here should sound like professional workplace writing. Check that none of them slip into a casual tone that would feel out of place in an email to a manager.
quests.explanation: The formal opening states the purpose directly and politely. The reason explains the cause without excessive apology, and the specific request names a clear, reasonable ask. The formal close ends politely, consistent in register with everything before it.
quests.thesisStatement: A short, specific extension request, grounded in a clear reason, is more likely to be granted than a vague one.

quests.instruction: Arrange this workplace message so its tone remains consistently professional, without slipping into either stiffness or excessive casualness.
quests.essayTopic: Write a professional message to a colleague declining an invitation to lead a new project
options: Thanks again for the opportunity, and I hope the project goes well.
My current workload would not let me give it the attention it deserves over the next few months.
Thank you for thinking of me for the new project; I have decided not to take it on at this time.
I would be glad to help identify someone else on the team who might be a strong fit, if that would be useful.
quests.hint: Check that the tone stays consistently professional and warm throughout, avoiding both overly stiff formality and overly casual phrasing.
quests.explanation: The polite opening states the decision clearly and appreciatively. The reason explains the decision honestly without over-apologising, and the alternative offered keeps the message constructive. The polite close ends warmly, matching the tone set at the opening.
quests.thesisStatement: Declining an opportunity honestly, while offering a constructive alternative, preserves a professional relationship.

quests.instruction: Order this professional message so its register stays appropriate for a workplace audience from start to finish.
quests.essayTopic: Write a professional message asking a client for feedback after completing a project
options: Thank you again for the opportunity to work together, and I look forward to hearing from you.
I hope the final deliverables met your expectations, and I wanted to follow up briefly.
Feedback like this helps us improve how we approach similar projects in the future.
Would you be willing to share any feedback on the project, whether about the process or the final result?
quests.hint: Check that every sentence matches a consistent, professional register suited to writing to a client, neither too stiff nor too casual.
quests.explanation: The polite opening checks in respectfully. The specific request asks clearly for what is wanted, and the reason for asking explains the value of the feedback without sounding demanding. The polite close ends warmly and professionally, consistent with the rest of the message.
quests.thesisStatement: A specific, well-justified request for feedback is more likely to receive a genuine response than a vague one.

quests.instruction: This paragraph avoids overclaiming. Order it so the qualified version of the claim appears where an exaggerated one would have weakened the argument.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph evaluating the effectiveness of a new productivity app
options: It is worth noting that self-reported data cannot fully rule out other factors that may have also contributed.
The app's reminders seem to catch small delays before they grow into larger ones.
The new productivity app appears to help many users manage their time more effectively.
Users tracking their own habits reported completing more planned tasks in the weeks after adopting it.
quests.hint: An exaggerated version might claim the app 'transforms productivity for everyone.' Check that this paragraph instead qualifies its claim appropriately throughout.
quests.explanation: The qualified claim opens with careful, appropriately hedged language rather than an exaggerated promise. The evidence and explanation support that measured claim, and the honest limit closes by acknowledging what the evidence cannot fully establish, avoiding overclaiming to the very end.
quests.thesisStatement: The new productivity app appears to help many users manage their time more effectively, though the evidence has limits.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so its language stays appropriately measured rather than sliding into exaggeration.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph evaluating the effectiveness of a new employee wellness programme
options: Employees who joined the programme reported somewhat lower stress scores on a company survey compared to non-participants.
The wellness programme seems to have modestly improved reported stress levels among participating employees.
The comparison is not a controlled study, so other factors could also be contributing to the difference.
Regular breaks built into the programme may be giving employees small, consistent moments of recovery throughout the day.
quests.hint: An exaggerated version might claim the programme 'eliminates workplace stress.' Check that this paragraph instead uses careful, honest language throughout.
quests.explanation: The qualified claim opens with modest, appropriately hedged language. The evidence and explanation support that careful claim without overstating it, and the honest limit closes by naming what the comparison cannot fully rule out.
quests.thesisStatement: The wellness programme seems to have modestly improved reported stress levels, though the evidence remains limited.

quests.instruction: Arrange this paragraph so every sentence avoids overstating what the evidence can actually support.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph evaluating the effectiveness of a new customer loyalty programme
options: The small rewards may be giving customers just enough extra reason to choose the store over a competitor.
Since enrollment was voluntary, more loyal customers may have simply been more likely to join in the first place.
Customers enrolled in the programme made slightly more repeat purchases over six months than those who did not join.
The new loyalty programme appears to have modestly increased how often existing customers return.
quests.hint: An exaggerated version might claim the programme 'guarantees customer loyalty.' Check that this paragraph instead stays carefully measured throughout.
quests.explanation: The qualified claim opens with modest, carefully hedged language. The evidence and explanation support that measured claim, and the honest limit closes by naming a specific reason the comparison might be misleading, avoiding an overstated conclusion.
quests.thesisStatement: The new loyalty programme appears to have modestly increased repeat purchases, though the comparison has a clear limitation.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so its hedging language matches the actual strength of the evidence at each point.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph discussing what current evidence suggests about screen time and children's attention spans
options: Parents should weigh the strongest evidence more heavily than the more speculative claims still being studied.
Some researchers have speculated that early screen exposure could affect long-term attention development, but this claim remains largely untested.
Frequent app-switching during the day may also affect sustained attention, though the evidence here is less extensive.
Excessive screen time before bed clearly disrupts children's sleep, a finding consistent across dozens of studies.
quests.hint: Match each hedge word to how solid the actual evidence is: 'clearly' for strong evidence, 'may' for moderate evidence, and 'speculated' for weak evidence.
quests.explanation: The strongly supported point uses confident language appropriate to well-established evidence. The appropriately hedged point uses a moderate hedge for less extensive evidence, and the weakly supported point uses the most cautious language for a largely untested claim. The closing caution advises weighing them accordingly.
quests.thesisStatement: Current evidence on screen time and attention varies in strength, from well-established sleep effects to speculative long-term claims.

quests.instruction: Arrange this paragraph so its qualifying language accurately reflects how strong the evidence actually is at each stage.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph discussing what current evidence suggests about the benefits of standing desks
options: Standing desks clearly reduce the amount of time office workers spend sitting, a finding confirmed across many workplace studies.
They may also modestly reduce lower back discomfort for some users, though results here vary more between studies.
Some early research has suggested a possible link to improved long-term cardiovascular health, but this claim needs far more evidence before it can be trusted.
Workers considering a standing desk should treat the sitting-time benefit as established and the health claims as still uncertain.
quests.hint: Match the language to the evidence: confident wording for the clearly established finding, a softer hedge for the mixed finding, and the most cautious wording for the speculative claim.
quests.explanation: The strongly supported point uses confident language for well-established evidence. The appropriately hedged point uses a moderate hedge for mixed findings, and the weakly supported point uses the most cautious language for an unproven claim. The closing caution advises treating each claim according to its actual strength.
quests.thesisStatement: Standing desks clearly reduce sitting time, though claims about broader health benefits remain far less certain.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so its hedges accurately track the actual strength of evidence, from well-established to merely speculative.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph discussing what current evidence suggests about the effects of intermittent fasting
options: Intermittent fasting clearly leads to short-term weight loss for many people, a finding replicated across numerous controlled studies.
It may also modestly improve certain blood sugar markers, though the evidence here is more mixed across different populations.
Readers should treat the weight loss finding as well-supported and the ageing claims as still highly uncertain.
Some researchers have speculated about potential long-term effects on ageing, but this claim remains far from settled.
quests.hint: Match each sentence's confidence to the underlying evidence: strong language for replicated findings, a softer hedge for mixed evidence, and cautious language for speculation.
quests.explanation: The strongly supported point uses confident language for a well-replicated finding. The appropriately hedged point uses a moderate hedge for mixed evidence, and the weakly supported point uses the most cautious language for unsettled speculation. The closing caution advises weighing each claim by its actual evidence.
quests.thesisStatement: Intermittent fasting clearly supports short-term weight loss, though claims about long-term ageing effects remain highly uncertain.

quests.instruction: Order this professional message so it handles a sensitive workplace issue with appropriate tact throughout.
quests.essayTopic: Write a professional message to a team about a missed project deadline
options: I appreciate your patience, and please reach out if this timing creates any issues on your end.
The report due this week will be delivered two days late, and I wanted to flag that directly rather than let the date pass quietly.
An unexpected data issue on our end took longer to resolve than anyone anticipated when the original deadline was set.
The team is prioritising this over other tasks for the next two days to ensure the delay does not extend further.
quests.hint: The message should acknowledge the problem honestly without assigning blame to any individual, and should close by inviting further conversation professionally.
quests.explanation: The direct acknowledgement states the issue plainly and early, respecting the reader's need to know. The explanation accounts for the cause without blaming anyone specifically, and the path forward shows concrete action. The professional close invites dialogue while staying courteous.
quests.thesisStatement: Communicating a delay honestly and early, without blame, preserves trust better than a vague or defensive message would.

quests.instruction: Arrange this professional message so it maintains appropriate tact while still being direct about a real problem.
quests.essayTopic: Write a professional message to a supplier about a recurring quality issue with recent shipments
options: We would like to schedule a call this week to discuss how quality checks might be adjusted going forward.
We recognise that supply chain pressures this quarter may have made maintaining the usual standard more difficult than expected.
The last three shipments have included a higher number of defective units than our agreement typically allows.
We value the partnership and are confident this can be resolved together.
quests.hint: The message should name the problem clearly and early, avoid assigning blame outright, and close by proposing a constructive next step.
quests.explanation: The direct acknowledgement names the issue plainly, respecting the relationship enough to be honest. The explanation offers a charitable, non-accusatory possible cause, and the path forward proposes a specific, constructive action. The professional close reaffirms the relationship's value.
quests.thesisStatement: Raising a quality issue directly but without blame, while proposing a concrete next step, preserves a professional partnership.

quests.instruction: Order this professional message so it addresses a difficult performance conversation with appropriate care.
quests.essayTopic: Write a professional message from a manager to an employee about inconsistent recent performance
options: I appreciate the work you've been putting in, and I want to make sure you have what you need going forward.
I wanted to check in, since your last few reports have taken noticeably longer to complete than usual.
Let's set aside some time this week to talk through what support might help, whether that means adjusting deadlines or redistributing some tasks.
I know the team has been managing a heavier workload than normal this quarter, and that may be part of what is happening.
quests.hint: The message should name the concern honestly and early, offer a genuine, non-accusatory possible explanation, and close by supporting rather than criticising.
quests.explanation: The direct acknowledgement raises the concern honestly and specifically. The explanation offers a fair, contextual possibility rather than an accusation, and the path forward proposes a concrete, supportive next step. The professional close reaffirms appreciation, closing on a constructive note.
quests.thesisStatement: Raising a performance concern honestly, with a fair explanation and a supportive next step, preserves trust in a working relationship.

quests.instruction: Order this academic paragraph so its tone remains appropriately formal and evidence-based throughout.
quests.essayTopic: Write an academic paragraph discussing the relationship between sleep and memory consolidation
options: This effect is thought to result from the reactivation of neural patterns associated with recent learning during particular sleep stages.
These findings collectively suggest that sleep should be considered an active component of the learning process rather than a passive rest period.
A substantial body of research indicates that sleep plays a critical role in consolidating newly formed memories.
Studies comparing recall performance after a period of sleep versus an equivalent period of wakefulness consistently favour the sleep condition.
quests.hint: Every sentence here should maintain a consistently formal, academic register, citing evidence and discussing mechanisms in measured, scholarly language.
quests.explanation: The academic claim opens with formal, hedged language appropriate to scholarly writing. The evidence cited supports that claim with a specific comparison, and the mechanism discussed accounts for it using academic phrasing. The scholarly closing draws a broader conclusion in the same register.
quests.thesisStatement: Sleep plays a critical role in consolidating newly formed memories, according to a substantial body of research.

quests.instruction: Arrange this academic paragraph so its formal, evidence-based tone remains consistent throughout.
quests.essayTopic: Write an academic paragraph discussing the effect of exercise on cognitive function in older adults
options: Longitudinal studies tracking participants over several years report smaller declines in memory and processing speed among those who exercised regularly.
This association is often attributed to increased blood flow to the brain and the promotion of new neural connections.
Regular aerobic exercise appears to be associated with improved cognitive function in older adults.
Taken together, this evidence supports incorporating regular physical activity into strategies for healthy cognitive ageing.
quests.hint: Check that the paragraph maintains formal, hedged academic language throughout, avoiding casual phrasing or overstated certainty.
quests.explanation: The academic claim opens with appropriately hedged, formal language. The evidence cited supports it with specific study findings, and the mechanism discussed accounts for the association using academic phrasing. The scholarly closing draws a measured, practical conclusion in the same register.
quests.thesisStatement: Regular aerobic exercise appears to be associated with improved cognitive function in older adults, according to longitudinal research.

quests.instruction: Order this academic paragraph so its scholarly register stays consistent from claim to conclusion.
quests.essayTopic: Write an academic paragraph discussing the impact of bilingualism on cognitive flexibility
options: This advantage is often explained by the constant practice bilingual speakers gain in suppressing one language while actively using another.
Bilingual participants consistently outperform monolingual counterparts on tasks requiring rapid switching between competing rules or categories.
Collectively, these findings position bilingualism as a potentially valuable factor in broader theories of cognitive development.
Bilingualism has been associated with enhanced cognitive flexibility across a range of experimental studies.
quests.hint: Maintain a formal, hedged academic register throughout, using phrases like 'has been associated with' rather than blunt, casual claims.
quests.explanation: The academic claim opens with appropriately hedged, formal phrasing. The evidence cited supports it with specific comparative findings, and the mechanism discussed explains the advantage using scholarly language. The scholarly closing situates the finding within a broader theoretical context.
quests.thesisStatement: Bilingualism has been associated with enhanced cognitive flexibility, according to a range of experimental studies.

quests.instruction: This paragraph should sound like natural, thoughtful writing rather than stiff or overly formal phrasing. Order it accordingly.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph explaining why walking meetings can improve a team's conversations
options: Without eye contact locked in place, people often speak more freely and interrupt each other less.
Sometimes the best way to think clearly is to stop sitting still.
Something about walking side by side seems to loosen up a conversation that would feel stiff sitting across a table.
One team reported their best ideas for a tricky project came during a fifteen-minute walk, not the hour-long meeting that followed it.
quests.hint: Check that the claim and closing lines sound like natural, conversational writing rather than stiff, overly formal phrasing packed with jargon.
quests.explanation: The natural claim opens with plain, thoughtful language rather than stiff phrasing. The reason explains the mechanism simply, and the concrete detail grounds it in a specific, relatable case. The natural closing lands the point in an easy, memorable sentence rather than a formal summary.
quests.thesisStatement: Walking meetings can improve a team's conversations by loosening the stiffness that comes with sitting face to face.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so it reads naturally, avoiding stiff or jargon-heavy phrasing at every point.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph explaining why handwritten thank-you notes still matter in a digital workplace
options: A handwritten note still lands differently than an email, even in an office that runs almost entirely on screens.
Some gestures matter precisely because they take longer than they need to.
One manager who switched to handwritten notes for small wins said employees started keeping them pinned to their desks, something no email ever earned.
Taking the time to write by hand signals a kind of effort that a quick typed message rarely carries.
quests.hint: Check that no sentence relies on stiff or unnecessarily formal phrasing. This should read like natural, thoughtful prose throughout.
quests.explanation: The natural claim opens with plain, direct language. The reason explains the mechanism in accessible terms, and the concrete detail grounds it in a specific, human example. The natural closing lands the point in a simple, memorable sentence.
quests.thesisStatement: Handwritten thank-you notes still matter in a digital workplace because the effort itself carries meaning an email cannot.

quests.instruction: Arrange this paragraph so its phrasing stays natural and readable throughout, avoiding anything stiff or overly formal.
quests.essayTopic: Write a body paragraph explaining why a short daily check-in improved a remote team's sense of connection
options: Sometimes staying connected is less about what gets said and more about simply showing up.
Talking briefly every day, rather than only when something urgent came up, made the team feel like colleagues instead of separate contractors.
One team member said the check-in was the only time all day she actually heard another human voice while working from home.
A ten-minute daily check-in ended up doing more for the team's sense of connection than any single big meeting ever did.
quests.hint: Check that every sentence, especially the claim and closing, uses natural, plain phrasing rather than stiff or overly formal language.
quests.explanation: The natural claim opens with plain, direct language rather than stiff phrasing. The reason explains the mechanism accessibly, and the concrete detail grounds it in a specific, human moment. The natural closing lands the point simply and memorably.
quests.thesisStatement: A short daily check-in improved a remote team's sense of connection by making regular contact feel normal rather than exceptional.

quests.instruction: Integrate precision and appropriate professional register in one paragraph written for a workplace report.
quests.essayTopic: Write a paragraph for a workplace report explaining why a new inventory system reduced stock discrepancies
options: This figure reflects a comparison against the same quarter last year, using identical reporting categories for consistency.
The system's barcode scanning at each stage of handling appears to have reduced the manual entry errors that previously accounted for most discrepancies.
These results support continuing the current system beyond its initial trial period.
The new inventory system reduced recorded stock discrepancies by 31 percent over the past quarter.
quests.hint: This paragraph should be both precise, using exact figures, and appropriately professional in tone throughout, suitable for a formal report.
quests.explanation: The precise claim opens with an exact figure rather than a vague estimate. The professional evidence clarifies the basis for that figure formally, and the explanation accounts for the mechanism in measured, professional language. The professional closing recommends action in appropriately formal terms.
quests.thesisStatement: The new inventory system reduced recorded stock discrepancies by 31 percent over the past quarter.

quests.instruction: Order this paragraph so it maintains both precision and an appropriately academic register throughout.
quests.essayTopic: Write an academic paragraph discussing the measured effect of a classroom intervention on student participation
options: The intervention was associated with a 24 percent increase in measured student participation over the study period.
This figure was derived from classroom observation coded independently by two researchers, with high agreement between coders.
These findings suggest that structural changes to discussion format may be as influential as content-based interventions.
The structured turn-taking protocol appears to have reduced the tendency for a small number of students to dominate discussion.
quests.hint: This paragraph should combine an exact figure with formal, hedged academic phrasing throughout, avoiding both vagueness and casual tone.
quests.explanation: The precise claim opens with an exact figure rather than a vague estimate. The academic evidence explains the methodology behind that figure in formal terms, and the explanation accounts for the mechanism using academic phrasing. The scholarly closing draws a broader, appropriately hedged conclusion.
quests.thesisStatement: A structured turn-taking protocol was associated with a 24 percent increase in measured student participation.

quests.instruction: Arrange this paragraph so precision and professional register work together for a formal business proposal.
quests.essayTopic: Write a paragraph for a business proposal explaining the projected savings from switching to a new supplier
options: Switching to the proposed supplier is projected to save approximately £48,000 annually based on current order volumes.
Given these figures, we recommend proceeding with a three-month trial period before finalising a longer-term contract.
The saving stems primarily from reduced shipping costs due to the supplier's closer regional distribution centre.
This estimate reflects the supplier's quoted per-unit price applied to our average monthly order over the past twelve months.
quests.hint: This paragraph should combine an exact projected figure with formally professional language suitable for a business audience.
quests.explanation: The precise claim opens with an exact projected figure rather than a vague estimate. The professional evidence explains the basis for that figure formally, and the explanation accounts for the mechanism in clear business terms. The professional closing recommends a specific, cautious next step.
quests.thesisStatement: Switching to the proposed supplier is projected to save approximately £48,000 annually, primarily through reduced shipping costs.

quests.instruction: Full capstone: combine precision, appropriate qualification, professional register, and natural phrasing in one paragraph.
quests.essayTopic: Write a paragraph for a workplace report evaluating the early results of a new flexible scheduling policy
options: Unplanned absences fell from an average of 4.2 per month to 2.8 per month across the three departments that piloted the policy.
Early data suggests that the flexible scheduling policy has modestly reduced unplanned absences, though the trial period remains short.
Employees may be using the flexibility to manage minor personal obligations that previously required taking a full day off.
These early results are promising, though a longer observation period would help confirm whether the trend holds.
quests.hint: This capstone should combine an exact figure, honest hedging language, professional tone, and natural, non-robotic phrasing all at once.
quests.explanation: The precise and qualified claim opens with an exact figure alongside honest hedging about the trial's limits. The evidence supports it with specific numbers, and the explanation offers a plausible, appropriately hedged mechanism. The measured closing recommends caution without dismissing the promising result.
quests.thesisStatement: Early data suggests the flexible scheduling policy has modestly reduced unplanned absences, though longer observation is needed to confirm the trend.

quests.instruction: Capstone: build a paragraph that is precise, appropriately hedged, professionally toned, and naturally phrased all at once.
quests.essayTopic: Write a paragraph for a workplace report evaluating the early results of a new employee mentorship programme
options: Six-month retention among mentored new hires reached 89 percent, compared with 74 percent among those without a mentor.
The gap is encouraging, but a full year of data would give a clearer picture before expanding the programme company-wide.
Having a designated point of contact appears to reduce the isolation that often drives early departures in a new role.
Early results suggest the mentorship programme may be improving new hire retention, though the sample size so far remains small.
quests.hint: This capstone paragraph should combine exact figures, honest hedges about sample size, professional tone, and natural rather than stiff phrasing.
quests.explanation: The precise and qualified claim opens with a specific figure alongside an honest caveat about sample size. The evidence supports it with exact comparative numbers, and the explanation offers a plausible, naturally phrased mechanism. The measured closing recommends caution while acknowledging genuine promise.
quests.thesisStatement: Early results suggest the mentorship programme may be improving new hire retention, though a larger sample would confirm the trend.

quests.instruction: Final capstone of this file: write a paragraph that fully integrates precision, honest qualification, professional register, and natural phrasing.
quests.essayTopic: Write a paragraph for a workplace report evaluating the early results of a new customer feedback system
options: Real-time alerts appear to be catching problems that used to surface only once a customer eventually filed a formal complaint.
Initial figures suggest the new feedback system may be surfacing complaints earlier, though it has only been active for six weeks.
The average time between a customer issue occurring and it being flagged internally dropped from eleven days to four.
The early trend is encouraging, but a longer trial would help confirm whether the improvement holds as the novelty of the new system wears off.
quests.hint: This final paragraph should show full mastery: an exact figure, an honest limitation, professional tone, and phrasing that still reads naturally rather than stiffly.
quests.explanation: The precise and qualified claim opens with a specific figure alongside an honest caveat about the short trial period. The evidence supports it with an exact comparison, and the explanation offers a clear, naturally phrased mechanism. The measured closing recommends patience while acknowledging real promise.
quests.thesisStatement: Initial figures suggest the new feedback system may be surfacing complaints earlier, though a longer trial is needed to confirm the trend holds.
